description: Read a chunk of raw MDX from a document’s root or a child page. Omit pageId for root content; obtain child IDs from list_pages. Returns revision, totalLength, and nextOffset; continue at nextOffset until null and reuse expectedRevision across chunks. A revision conflict requires restarting retrieval.

contentLimit.description: Maximum characters to return, from 1 to 64000; defaults to 64000.

contentOffset.description: Zero-based character offset; use the previous response’s nextOffset to continue.

expectedRevision.description: Current document revision from get_document, open_document, list_pages, read_page, or a previous save. A stale revision fails with revision_conflict; retrieve the current snapshot before retrying.

id.description: Document ID returned by search, list_documents, list_project_documents, or create_document; not its URL or slug.

pageId.description: Child page ID from list_pages; omit to read the document’s root content.

name: read_page
title: Read Page
